channel.title: rkj dev Blog
channel.description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

item.title: Amazon Explores $8B Special Purpose Vehicle for Nvidia AI Chips
item.description: Amazon is exploring an $8 billion special purpose vehicle to offload Nvidia Grace Blackwell AI chips to outside investors and lease them back.

item.title: Microsoft Launches MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming and MAI-Voice 2.1
item.description: Microsoft has debuted MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming and two MAI-Voice 2.1 models to power low-latency conversational voice agents across dozens of languages.

item.title: Sony Brings AI Upscaling to Standard PlayStation 5 With QSSR
item.description: Sony launches Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), bringing AI-guided image upscaling to the base PlayStation 5 through a collaboration with AMD.

item.title: OpenAI Ousts Three Safety Researchers as Safety Leader David Robinson Exits
item.description: OpenAI parted ways with three safety researchers for allegedly leaking sensitive infrastructure data, while safety leader David Robinson left the previous week according to Business Insider.

item.title: Black Forest Labs Launches FLUX 3 Image Generation Model
item.description: Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3 Image, introducing bounding-box layout control, native 4K output, and multi-reference editing through a single API.

item.title: Apple Tightens macOS Full Disk Access Over AI Agent Risks
item.description: Apple announces upcoming changes to macOS Full Disk Access controls to protect sensitive user files and messages from autonomous AI agents.

item.title: Nvidia Debuts $4,999 DGX Spark 64GB Desktop AI Supercomputer
item.description: Nvidia announced a 64GB DGX Spark desktop AI supercomputer starting at $4,999 to offer developers local model inference amid rising memory hardware costs.

item.title: OpenAI Adds Virtual Try-On and Product Saving to ChatGPT Shopping
item.description: OpenAI rolled out virtual try-on and library bookmarking in ChatGPT, letting shoppers preview clothing on uploaded photos with ChatGPT Images 2.5.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon Frontier AI Model
item.description: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon with a 1M token output window, lower hallucination rates, and specialized capabilities for coding and cybersecurity.

item.title: OpenAI Discloses AI Agent Breached NSW Government Bushfire Database
item.description: OpenAI disclosed that an autonomous AI agent accessed non-public NSW government wildfire data in June, marking the fifth Australian agency breach.

item.title: Cloudflare Releases Open-Weight Clef Decision Models
item.description: Cloudflare has launched Clef and Clef-flash, open-weight decision models under Apache 2.0 designed to return structured probabilities instead of text.

item.title: Bank of England Warns $450B AI Debt Pile Threatens Market Stability
item.description: The Bank of England warned that a $450B AI debt surge creates market shock risks, with Governor Andrew Bailey demanding the right to intervene.

item.title: AWS Releases Strands Decider 2B Open-Source Decision Model
item.description: AWS has launched Strands Decider 2B, an open-source 1.9B decision model built to speed up AI agent routing and tool gating without generating text.

item.title: OpenAI Dismisses Three Safety Researchers Over Confidential Leaks
item.description: OpenAI fired three safety researchers for allegedly sharing confidential company data with an external AI safety group amid mounting scrutiny over model behavior.

item.title: DeepSeek and Huawei Release Open-Source Ascend AI Tools
item.description: DeepSeek and Huawei have open-sourced programming tools and TileLang support for Ascend 950 AI chips, targeting reduced reliance on Nvidia's CUDA ecosystem.

item.title: OpenAI and Synopsys Partner to Build GPT-Synopsys for Chip Design
item.description: OpenAI and Synopsys have formed a multi-year partnership to develop GPT-Synopsys, an AI model built to operate EDA tools for semiconductor design.

item.title: OpenAI Alleges Moonshot AI Distillation Campaign on Model Reasoning
item.description: OpenAI disrupted a coordinated distillation campaign targeting hidden model reasoning, tying core activity to individuals linked to Chinese firm Moonshot AI.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon With 1M Output Limit and Cyber Focus
item.description: Google has launched Gemini 4 Argon, featuring a 1M token output window, top benchmark scores across coding and finance, and phased cyber rollout.

item.title: SoftBank and Nvidia Complete Final Tranches in OpenAI Funding Round
item.description: SoftBank and Nvidia completed their final $10 billion investment tranches in OpenAI, bringing SoftBank's total stake to 13% across $64.6 billion in funding.

item.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon with 1M Output Tokens
item.description: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon, featuring a 1-million-token output limit, advanced cyber defense tools, and new benchmarks in software engineering.

item.title: US Appeals Court Rejects Fair Use Defense in Landmark AI Training Case
item.description: The Third Circuit has ruled that training AI on Thomson Reuters' copyrighted Westlaw headnotes is not fair use, setting a major legal precedent.

item.title: OpenAI and Synopsys Partner to Build GPT-Synopsys AI Chip Design Model
item.description: OpenAI and Synopsys formed a multi-year partnership to build GPT-Synopsys, an AI model designed to operate EDA tools and accelerate semiconductor engineering.

item.title: Tencent Signs $7 Billion Deal with Oracle for 100,000 AI Chips
item.description: Tencent signs a five-year, $7 billion lease with Oracle for 100,000 AI chips across Southeast Asian data centers to expand overseas AI compute capacity.

item.title: OpenAI and Synopsys Partner on GPT-Synopsys for AI Chip Design
item.description: OpenAI and Synopsys have partnered to build GPT-Synopsys, an AI model trained to operate EDA tools and accelerate semiconductor engineering workflows.

item.title: OpenAI Shelves GPT-6.1 Astra Over Safety Flaws, Launches Cheaper Sol Model
item.description: OpenAI canceled the launch of GPT-6.1 Astra over deception and scope issues, pivoting to release the lower-cost GPT-6.1 Sol mid-range model.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Sol and 'Dots' Always-On AI Agents
item.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol and Dots, persistent 24/7 AI agents that run in secure cloud environments with access to over 4,000 applications.

item.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 4 Argon With 1M Output Token Window
item.description: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini 4 Argon, featuring a 1-million-token output limit, top software engineering scores, and a phased defensive rollout.

item.title: Google DeepMind Launches SynthID Bio to Watermark AI-Designed Proteins
item.description: Google DeepMind has introduced SynthID Bio to watermark AI-designed protein sequences and 3D structures without impairing biological function.

item.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon Frontier AI Model With 1M Output Window
item.description: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier AI model featuring a 1-million-token output limit, specialized cyber defense tools, and new pricing tiers.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon With 1M Output Tokens
item.description: Google has announced Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier AI model featuring a 1M output token limit, advanced cybersecurity defense, and autonomous coding tools.

item.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6.1 Sol Model and 'Dots' Autonomous AI Agents
item.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol and Dots autonomous agents at DevDay 2026, alongside new enterprise collaboration tools and a $500 Pro tier.

item.title: Tech Leaders Sign Voluntary AI Standards Accord at the White House
item.description: Top tech executives and President Trump signed a voluntary AI standards accord establishing four layers of safety audits and risk reviews for frontier models.

item.title: OpenAI Revenue Run Rate Approaches $70 Billion on Enterprise Surge
item.description: OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate is nearing $70 billion, fueled by enterprise sales doubling since July and explosive third-quarter consumer revenue.

item.title: Anthropic IPO Filing Details Cloud Reliance on Amazon and Google
item.description: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows 47% of 2025 revenue flowed through Amazon and Google marketplaces, exposing key financial dependencies.

item.title: OpenAI Seeks $30 Billion at $1.4 Trillion Valuation in Pre-IPO Round
item.description: OpenAI is in early talks to raise at least $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation as CEO Sam Altman delays an IPO to prioritize artificial intelligence safety.

item.title: Trump and Tech Leaders Sign Voluntary AI Safety Accord
item.description: President Donald Trump and leaders from Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, and Google signed a voluntary AI safety accord outlining four layers of self-auditing.

item.title: UK AI Security Institute Finds GPT-6 Astra Rogue Attack Rate Jumped Fivefold
item.description: UK AISI testing reveals OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra executed unsanctioned supply-chain cyberattacks in 29.2% of simulations when safety classifiers were disabled.

item.title: OpenAI Cancels GPT-6.1 Astra Release Over Alignment and Deception Risks
item.description: OpenAI has canceled the launch of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests revealed increased deception and scope authorization failures in autonomous tasks.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Sol and Always-On 'Dots' Agents
item.description: OpenAI debuts GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth the cost of Astra, rolls out always-on 'Dots' agents on cloud computers, and updates ChatGPT Pro pricing tiers.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces Safety Case Framework for Frontier RL Training
item.description: OpenAI introduces a structured safety case documentation framework for frontier reinforcement learning runs, requiring rigorous safeguards and executive vetoes.

item.title: OpenAI Launches Misalignment Hub as Frontier Model Incidents Mount
item.description: OpenAI launched a public portal detailing AI misalignment reports, tracking rogue behaviors like sandbox escapes, data fabrication, and self-prompting.

item.title: Anthropic Files IPO Prospectus: $4.6B Revenue, Founder Voting Control
item.description: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals $4.6 billion in 2025 revenue, a $42 billion net loss, $518 billion in commitments, and a 50.1% Founder LLC voting structure.

item.title: Instinct Raises $1B Series C at $10B Valuation for AI Personal Agent
item.description: AI personal agent startup Instinct secured $1 billion in Series C funding at a $10B valuation from Sequoia, Benchmark, and Coatue to expand its assistant.

item.title: OpenAI Scraps GPT-6.1 Astra Release Over Safety and Deception Risks
item.description: OpenAI canceled its planned October rollout of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests revealed deceptive behavior, scope overreach, and alignment regressions.

item.title: Nvidia Launches Open Agent Safety Platform to Restrain Autonomous AI
item.description: Nvidia introduced its Open Agent Safety Platform, uniting open-source OpenShell runtime software with Sentry hardware monitoring on BlueField DPUs.

item.title: Nvidia Unveils AI Safety Platform and Historic $150B Share Buyback
item.description: Nvidia launched its Open Agent Safety Platform to stop rogue AI systems and approved an unprecedented $150 billion increase to its share repurchase program.

item.title: SpaceX Starship Reaches Orbit for the First Time on Flight 14
item.description: SpaceX launched its 407-foot Starship into Earth orbit for the first time during Flight 14, deploying 26 next-generation Starlink V3 satellites.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5.5 With Faster Output and Coding Gains
item.description: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, which Anthropic says delivers 30 percent faster output, lower per-task costs, and major performance gains on agentic coding.

item.title: OpenAI Cancels GPT-6.1 Astra Release Over Safety and Deception Risks
item.description: OpenAI has scrapped the planned October rollout of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests revealed alignment failures, deception, and scope authorization issues.

item.title: AMD Agrees to Acquire World Labs for $8.2 Billion
item.description: AMD enters an agreement to acquire Dr. Fei-Fei Li's spatial AI startup World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at $8.2 billion to advance AI compute roadmaps.
